title: Collision distance
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the distance x0 = 6 m from the top where the first collision occurs.

title: Post-collision speeds
description: Essential: Correctly states the magnitudes v_A1 = 2 m/s and v_B1 = 4 m/s after the first elastic collision.

title: Energy and momentum conservation
description: Important: Applies both conservation of kinetic energy and conservation of momentum correctly for the elastic collision.

title: Acceleration analysis
description: Important: Correctly determines the accelerations of both blocks on the incline using forces and friction.

title: Kinematics for meeting
description: Important: Sets up and solves kinematic equations to find the time or position of the first collision.

title: B's final state reasoning
description: Important: Correctly concludes B does not reach the bottom and calculates its stopping distance from the bottom (3.8 m).

title: Infinite series or iterative analysis
description: Optional: Recognizes the pattern of repeated collisions and uses a geometric series to sum B's total displacement.

title: Sign/direction error
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly assigns signs for velocities or accelerations along the incline, leading to wrong meeting point or post-collision velocities.

title: Friction force mistake
description: Pitfall: Miscalculates the net acceleration of block B (e.g., wrong friction direction or magnitude).
